message.reasoning_content:
The kernel computes log1p via atanh-style approximation with FP32 arithmetic; tolerance 1e-6 absolute over entire domain including log(65504)≈11.09, and very small values near -1... Actually worst case: the polynomial coefficients look like 2*z*(1+z²*(1/3+0.2z²+...)) — 1/3, 1/5, 1/7 ≈ 0.33333, 0.2, 0.142857. That's ln(u) = 2*atanh((u-1)/(u+1)) with 3 terms. Error of truncated atanh series with z up to (mantissa... after halving, mantissa ≤1.65 in [1,1.65]) — actually the mantissa normalization makes m in [1,2), halved if >1.65 → z ∈ [0, 0.245]. Series truncation error ~ 2*z^9/9 ≈ 2*0.245^9/9 ≈ tiny. But coefficients truncated: 0.33333 instead of 1/3 (error 3.3e-6 in coefficient → error 3.3e-6*z ~ 8e-7*2 → hmm). Also exponent*log(2) split: high+low = 0.69313812256 + 0.0000090580006145 = 0.69314718... let's check: sum = 0.6931471805606145. ln2 = 0.6931471805599453. Good, ~7e-13 accurate.

But error 0.33333 vs 1/3: 1/3-0.33333=3.33e-6. Local_log = 2*z*(1+z²*poly). z for x small ≈ x/2, so log ≈ 2*(x/2)*(1+...*(0.33333)) ≈ x*(1+x/3). Error from coefficient: 2*z*z²*(3.33e-6) = 2z³*3.33e-6. z≤0.245 → z³≤0.0147 → error ≤ ~1e-7. Fine.

Bigger risk: for large x, u = 1+x in FP32 exactly represents FP16 value (FP16→FP32 exact). correction term handles rounding of 1+x — but FP32 1+x of FP16 x is exact! FP16 values have 11-bit mantissa; 1+x exact in FP32 always (need ≤24 bits). Actually for x tiny subnormal FP16 like 6e-8, 1+x in FP32: 1+6e-8 needs 2^-24 ~ 6e-8 → representable? FP16 smallest subnormal is 2^-24 ≈ 5.96e-8. 1+2^-24 rounds to 1 (half-ulp tie, round-to-even → 1). So u-1=0, x-(u-1)=x, correction = x/u = x. Then log1p computed via u's bits would give log(1)=0, but correction adds x ≈ x - x²/2... actual log1p(x)=x - x²/2 ≈ x. Error x²/2 ≈ 1.8e-15. Fine.

The real risk: near x = -1+2^-10 etc? Also make_inputs distribution. Just run a full-domain test: all FP16 values > -1, compute kernel output, compare with FP64 log1p, check max abs error ≤1e-6. That's decisive. Also test large x: u up to 65505, mantissa branch etc.

Let me record a claim and run a probe exhaustively over all positive legal FP16 values.
